paragraphs: Abba Yose ben Dostai: Sanhedrin 52a; Sifra, Shemini; Sifrei, Naso, the section ‘May the Lord lift His face toward you.’ Rabbi says in Abba Yose ben Dostai’s name: Yoma 22b, Menachot 52a, Zevachim 116b; Dinei Mamonot and Echad Dinei Mamonot; Rabbah, Naso, end of chapter 11, many things. Rabbah, Vayishlach, section 78, has Rav in Abba Yose ben Dostai’s name; Rav is a scribal error and should read Rabbi. Midrash Shmuel, chapter 32: ben Derusai. Chagigah 13b: Dosai; Ein Yaakov: Abba Yosef ben Dostai. Sifrei, Naso, in the section cited above, has Abba ben Yose, a scribal error, for it gives Abba Yose many times there. Rabbah, Metzora, section 17: Rabbi Yose ben Dosa. Berakhot 28a: Abba Yosef ben Dostai. Ellu Terefot 49a: Rav Yosef bar Dosai. In Rabbi Yose HaGelili’s name: Tosefta, Taanit, chapter 2. Shocher Tov, section 20: Rabbi Abba bar Dosai, who killed the demon [in the midrash, he helps one spirit kill the other]. In my opinion it should read Abba Yose ben Dostai. Abba Yose ben Dosai and Rabbi Yose ben Meshullam: Tosefta, end of Kelim, chapter 6.
